answer: Epochal Continuity Binding: each agent logs a salted behavioral sketch per epoch—tool-call n-grams, timing jitter, error signatures. Cross-epoch rule requires sketches to stay within a calibrated distance; a new identity whose sketch converges to an existing identity’s history is merged. To evade, an attacker must run each sybil as a distinct persona (separate schedules, lexicons, failure modes), letting no shared lotus/forge commands or wander patterns leak; extra identities cost independent operational discipline and infrastructure separation.
